chassis: existing Hub chassis — room socket, not a parallel site

empty_states.experience_pending: Forecast frozen. The observation window is open — results land here when they're independently observed, not before.
empty_states.no_choices: No admissible choices right now. NO_OP is always available — doing nothing on purpose beats doing the wrong thing.
empty_states.no_facts: No facts yet. Tell Naya where you want to go and she'll start gathering what's actually true.
empty_states.no_recommendation: No recommendation yet — the Reality screen comes first. Naya won't guess before the facts are in.

evidence_quality_weights.policy_note: PROPOSED anchors from the shipping contract, not ratified LAW; the surface renders them labelled

fact_ttls_seconds.note: protected authority and consent are LIVE-rechecked at execution irrespective of TTL; a stale result must never become a positive action input

journeys.intent: Limited funds, two weeks — what next?

mock_rules.expand: tap toggles the four layers: 200ms ease max-height + chevron rotate 180deg; prefers-reduced-motion => instant

mock_rules.js: page script must pass node --check with zero errors
mock_rules.network: none — zero http(s) resource URLs, zero fetch/XHR/WebSocket
